sourcePolicy: Nur Rebrickable Catalog Downloads/CSV, keine MOC-Dateien.
methodology: A collision-free radius-4 cylinder is not sufficient evidence that the cylinder is the intended minifigure hand grip. Visually confirmed false-positive grip features are versioned here and remain blocked until a source-backed intended connector or a separately reviewed placement profile exists.

reviews.note: Three-view inspection on 2026-10-11 confirmed that the selected cylinder places the tool body across the figure instead of seating the intended handle in the hand.
The detected long cylinder follows the musket barrel rather than the intended stock grip, so the resulting placement crosses the figure instead of being held by the handle.

reviews.catalogName: Equipment Underwater Scooter, 2 Bar Handles, Octagonal End
reviews.note: Three-view inspection on 2026-10-12 confirmed that the single selected handle places the two-handed scooter behind and through the figure instead of in front of both hands.
Three-view inspection on 2026-10-12 confirmed that the selected cylinder embeds the camcorder across the figure's waist instead of placing its intended handle in the hand.
Three-view inspection on 2026-10-12 confirmed that the selected cylinder places the Snitch across the figure's waist and torso instead of presenting it plausibly at the hand.
Three-view inspection on 2026-10-11 confirmed that the selected internal cylinder rotates the toolbox onto its side instead of suspending it from the top handle.

reviews.catalogName: Toolbox with Classic Space Logo Print
reviews.note: This printed toolbox reuses the same visually rejected grip feature as 98368 and would otherwise be rotated onto its side instead of hanging from the top handle.
